method: candidate-specific Monte Carlo lower-tail p-values plus intersection-union rejection
statistic: maximum over one candidate model of joint log likelihood summed across all six probes
decision: model_misspecified iff all candidate-specific p-values <= alpha
finite_sample_argument: Under correct known point parameters and independent exchangeable units, the true candidate's own rank p-value is super-uniform. Model misspecified requires all candidate p-values <= alpha, so false rejection is <= alpha for each in-family candidate. Ties are conservative.
limitations: public development recipes, not sealed holdouts
claim_ceiling: conditional finite-sample composite-null test; no physical or SOTA claim
